name: 打工人日历
description: A 2x2 home screen widget that shows yyyy.MM.dd, the weekday, and a hand-drawn office-worker doodle with a four-character mood. It follows statutory holidays and make-up workdays from one calendar you choose, otherwise ordinary workdays and weekends. Transparent background; text and frame color are yours to pick.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 2×2 桌面小组件：左上角 yyyy.MM.dd 和星期，下面是手绘打工人和四字短句，按法定节假日、调休补班、普通工作日、周末换状态。背景透明，文字和线框颜色自己选。
localizedDescriptions.en: A 2x2 home screen widget: yyyy.MM.dd and weekday top-left, a hand-drawn worker and a four-character mood below. It switches between statutory holidays, make-up workdays, ordinary workdays and weekends. Transparent background, with a text/frame color you choose.
